title: Validation and repair engine
objective: workctx context validate becomes a real integrity engine: typed-model document validation, ID and reference integrity, task-hierarchy and claim-temporal rules, secret and path safety, and pluggable projection-freshness — with stable, actionable diagnostic codes.
business_value: Deterministic validation is the trust anchor of the product (risk R-001); WP-300 preconditions and WP-310 quarantine both build on these checks, and users rely on actionable diagnostics to repair their workspaces.
scope: Rebuild src/workctx/validation/ into an engine that walks a context root and validates every canonical document through the integrated domain models (EntityFrontmatter, Task, ArtifactManifest, Observation, Claim, ContextConfig), reporting one diagnostic per failure with file path and stable code — the existing structural checks (required directories, UTF-8, absolute paths, secrets, federated_search) are preserved as engine rules

Reference integrity: every workctx:// URI in canonical documents parses, matches the active context (require_context), uses the D-018 vocabulary, and resolves to an existing entity in the workspace; unresolved external/artifact references are reported as advisories, not errors, per doc-03
Task hierarchy: run workctx.domain.tasks.validate_task_hierarchy across the workspace corpus and map violations to diagnostics; detect blocks/depends_on contradiction cycles per doc-03
Claim temporal rules per doc-03: no two current claims for the same single-valued subject+predicate with overlapping validity; supersession chains acyclic and targets existing

Projection freshness as a protocol: define a small FreshnessProbe interface the engine consumes optionally; ship a null implementation (always unknown) — the SQLite-backed probe is wired by the lead at integration with WP-210

Keep the consumed public interface stable: validate_workspace(root) -> ValidationReport and the public fields of ValidationReport/ValidationIssue/Severity that src/workctx/cli.py and the presentation layer read; extend with new codes and optional strictness parameter without breaking callers
Implement the --strict semantics at API level (warnings escalate to errors) without touching the CLI (lead wires the doc-04 flag at integration)
Document every diagnostic code with cause and repair action in docs/reference/validation-diagnostics.md
non_goals: No CLI changes (the --strict flag wiring and repair commands are lead/integration work)
No mutation or automatic repair execution — the engine reports repair actions, it does not perform them (repair execution arrives with WP-300 transactions)
No SQLite queries or projection internals (consume only the FreshnessProbe protocol you define)
No jsonschema at runtime: domain models are the runtime validators; JSON Schemas remain the public contract validated in dev tests (ADR 0008)
deliverables: Validation engine with typed rules, stable diagnostic codes, and FreshnessProbe protocol
acceptance_criteria: A workspace with an invalid document, a broken URI, a foreign-context URI, an unknown entity type, a task-hierarchy violation, a blocks/depends_on contradiction cycle, an overlapping current claim, and a supersession cycle produces one correctly-coded diagnostic each (negative fixtures per case)
A freshly initialized context validates clean; existing CLI validate tests pass unchanged (interface stability)
Strict mode escalates warnings to errors at API level, tested
Unresolvable artifact:// and external references are advisories, not errors
Every emitted code appears in docs/reference/validation-diagnostics.md with a repair action (test enforces the doc/code sync)
Diagnostics never echo secret-looking values back in messages (report the location, not the value)
security_constraints: Secret detection must not print matched values in diagnostics or logs
Fictional fixtures only; the engine reads, never writes, workspace content
stop_conditions: Any needed change to the frozen consumed interface (validate_workspace signature or the report/issue public fields the CLI reads)
Any needed change to domain models, adapters, or frozen files
A doc-03 validation rule that cannot be implemented without SQLite (record and defer to integration instead of importing the adapter)
